infrastructure.name: Dockerfile
infrastructure.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for the production Next.js 16 image: installs dependencies with a frozen pnpm lockfile, builds the standalone output with the public NEXT_PUBLIC_* build args, then ships a minimal Alpine runtime that runs as a non-root user on port 3000.

infrastructure.name: base
infrastructure.summary: Base stage: node:22-alpine with libc6-compat installed (for native deps expecting glibc symbols on musl) and Corepack enabled for pnpm; every later stage builds from it.

infrastructure.name: deps
infrastructure.summary: Installs dependencies with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` from only the lockfile-affecting files (package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, pnpm-workspace.yaml), so this layer caches across source-only changes.

infrastructure.name: builder
infrastructure.summary: Copies node_modules from deps plus the full source, injects NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY as build ARGs (Next inlines NEXT_PUBLIC_* vars into the client bundle at build time, not at container start), and runs `pnpm build`.

infrastructure.name: runner
infrastructure.summary: Minimal runtime stage: creates an unprivileged nextjs user, copies public/ and the traced standalone server plus static assets from builder, and runs `node server.js` on port 3000.

infrastructure.name: .dockerignore
infrastructure.summary: Build-context exclusions for the Docker image: strips node_modules, build output, VCS/CI/editor files, local tooling/docs, and every .env* secret except .env.example, so none of it is baked into an image layer.

infrastructure.name: ci-cd.yml
infrastructure.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that verifies every push and pull request against main (lint, test, build, typecheck) and, only on a push to main, builds and pushes the Docker image to Docker Hub.

infrastructure.name: verify
infrastructure.summary: Quality-gate job that checks out the repo, installs dependencies with pnpm, then runs lint, tests, a production build, and typecheck on every push and PR.

infrastructure.name: docker
infrastructure.summary: Publish job, gated on the verify job and on pushes to main, that logs into Docker Hub, derives image tags, and builds/pushes the image with GitHub Actions layer caching and public NEXT_PUBLIC_* build args.

infrastructure.name: heroui.css
infrastructure.summary: HeroUI v3 stylesheet scoped exclusively to the signed-in (/dashboard, /admin) route group: imports @heroui/styles/css, declares light-dark() theme tokens implementing the Mobbin design spec (.claude/skills/DESIGN-mobbin.md) under [data-wicloud-app], and pins HeroUI's --primary/--secondary/--default/--muted/--danger variables so the dashboard's contrast requirements hold. Imported only by app/(app)/layout.tsx so the marketing pages never download it.

file:app/(app)/dashboard/demandes/page.t.summary: Client request list (/dashboard/demandes): every request the caller has filed, rendered as a linked list (not a table, to stay readable on a phone) with status chip, type, related solution and relative timestamp.

file:app/(app)/dashboard/demos/actions.t.name: actions.ts
file:app/(app)/dashboard/demos/actions.t.summary: Customer-side server actions for the 'upload' demo block: start a processing run (re-checking entitlement and spending the demo.processing quota, currently unlimited since no service grants it) and submit an in-progress run once files are attached, notifying the desk.

file:app/(app)/dashboard/devis/[id]/acti.name: actions.ts
file:app/(app)/dashboard/devis/[id]/acti.summary: Client's accept/refuse decision on a quote (devis): a single UPDATE whose WHERE clause enforces both ownership and that the quote is still in 'envoye' status (so a replayed form post after withdrawal is a no-op), followed by staff notification and an admin e-mail.

file:app/(app)/dashboard/documents/page..name: page.tsx
file:app/(app)/dashboard/documents/page..summary: Client documents page (/dashboard/documents): every file exchanged across all of the client's requests in one list, with download links, a storage-quota meter, and a FileUpload panel disabled with an explanation when object storage isn't configured.

file:app/(app)/dashboard/notifications/M.name: MarkAllReadButton.tsx
file:app/(app)/dashboard/notifications/M.summary: Two small client buttons for the notification feed: 'mark all read' (a plain form-action submit) and 'clear read' (behind ConfirmButton's two-step arm/confirm control, since clearing deletes rows).

file:app/(app)/dashboard/notifications/a.name: actions.ts
file:app/(app)/dashboard/notifications/a.summary: Server actions for a client's own notification feed (mark-all-read, mark-one-read, delete-one, clear-read): every statement is scoped to the caller by its WHERE, so there is no permission key involved, only ownership; each ends by publishing a realtime nudge and revalidating both shell layouts.

file:app/(app)/dashboard/notifications/p.name: page.tsx
file:app/(app)/dashboard/notifications/p.summary: Client notification feed page (/dashboard/notifications): the last 100 notifications for the signed-in user with an unread count in the page description.

file:app/(app)/dashboard/page.tsx.name: page.tsx
file:app/(app)/dashboard/page.tsx.summary: Client dashboard home (/dashboard): a 'to-do first' layout — pending quotes and unpaid invoices at the top (the one thing blocking the agency's own work), stat tiles, recent requests, live services with hot-usage quota meters, entitled demos with expiry countdowns, and recent notifications.

file:app/(app)/dashboard/profil/actions..name: actions.ts
file:app/(app)/dashboard/profil/actions..summary: Client profile server action: updates identity fields only (name/phone/company). E-mail is deliberately not editable here — changing it is an authentication change that needs Better Auth's changeEmail verification flow, not yet wired up.

file:app/(app)/dashboard/profil/page.tsx.name: page.tsx
file:app/(app)/dashboard/profil/page.tsx.summary: Client profile page (/dashboard/profil): identity, password (only offered if a credential account exists — a Google-only account has none), connected-sessions list, and account deletion, plus a read-only account summary panel.

file:app/(auth)/acces-refuse/page.tsx.name: page.tsx
file:app/(auth)/acces-refuse/page.tsx.summary: The 403 landing page (/acces-refuse) that requirePermission() redirects a signed-in-but-unauthorized staff member to, naming the missing permission in plain French (e.g. 'Factures → Modifier') so it's actionable, with links back into /admin or /dashboard.

file:app/api/contact/route.ts.name: route.ts
file:app/api/contact/route.ts.summary: POST /api/contact — the public contact-form endpoint: verifies Cloudflare Turnstile (skipped if unconfigured, never breaking the form outright), stores the submission as a contact_leads row (previously it verified and silently dropped the message), notifies staff with leads:read, and e-mails the admin as a convenience copy.

file:app/api/demos/secret/route.ts.name: route.ts
file:app/api/demos/secret/route.ts.summary: POST /api/demos/secret — reveals one demo secret (test password, SSH key) to an entitled customer or demos:read staff and logs the reveal. A route rather than a server action because it returns a value to already-hydrated JS and needs Cache-Control: no-store; every condition (session, ban, entitlement, expiry, that the block still declares the secret) is re-checked from scratch rather than trusting the page that rendered the button.

file:app/api/documents/[kind]/[id]/route.name: route.ts
file:app/api/documents/[kind]/[id]/route.summary: API route that streams a generated PDF (devis or facture) for a given document id, enforcing ownership or the billing:read permission before rendering it with renderBillingPdf.

file:app/api/notifications/[id]/open/rou.name: route.ts
file:app/api/notifications/[id]/open/rou.summary: API route that marks a single notification as read for the current user and redirects to its target href, used when a user clicks a notification link.

file:app/api/notifications/route.ts.name: route.ts
file:app/api/notifications/route.ts.summary: API route returning the current user's unread notification count and a page of recent notifications, polled by the dashboard notification bell.

file:app/api/realtime/route.ts.name: route.ts
file:app/api/realtime/route.ts.summary: Server-Sent Events endpoint that streams live realtime events (unread count, notifications) to the signed-in user's browser tab, backed by Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY via lib/realtime.ts.

file:app/api/uploads/route.ts.name: route.ts
file:app/api/uploads/route.ts.summary: API route handling the full upload lifecycle: presigning S3-style PUT URLs, recording finished uploads as attachments after authorizing the target (request, message, demo, demo run, company, or site), and presigning downloads with per-target access checks.

file:app/media/[id]/route.ts.name: route.ts
file:app/media/[id]/route.ts.summary: Public route that streams a public image/video attachment from the private object storage bucket by its database id, passing through Range headers for video seeking and caching for a year.

file:components/dashboard/FilterBar.tsx.name: FilterBar.tsx
file:components/dashboard/FilterBar.tsx.summary: Client component rendering a debounced search box plus dropdown filters that write their state into the URL's search params, used across admin list pages.

file:components/dashboard/NotificationFe.name: NotificationFeed.tsx
file:components/dashboard/NotificationFe.summary: Renders a list of notification rows (read/unread styling, relative timestamps, mark-all-read/clear actions) shared by the dashboard and admin notification pages.

file:components/dashboard/PageHeader.tsx.name: PageHeader.tsx
file:components/dashboard/PageHeader.tsx.summary: Shared dashboard/admin layout primitives: a page title/back-link header, a bordered content Panel, and a StatTile metric card, used to keep list and detail pages visually consistent.

file:components/dashboard/ProfileForms.t.name: ProfileForms.tsx
file:components/dashboard/ProfileForms.t.summary: Client forms for the shared 'Mon profil' page (used by both dashboard and admin shells): identity fields, password change, active session list with revoke, and account deletion.

file:components/dashboard/QuotaMeter.tsx.name: QuotaMeter.tsx
file:components/dashboard/QuotaMeter.tsx.summary: Renders a single quota's usage as a labeled progress bar (percentage, used/limit, optional reset date), color-coded as it approaches its limit.

file:components/dashboard/pills.ts.name: pills.ts
file:components/dashboard/pills.ts.summary: Shared Tailwind class-string constants for pill/badge styling (primary, outline, soft, and a small-size modifier) reused across dashboard status chips and tags.

file:lib/account.ts.name: account.ts
file:lib/account.ts.summary: Account-side side effects shared across server actions: activity-log entries, creating and realtime-publishing notifications (single or bulk), resolving which staff hold a given permission, and reading unread/recent notifications for a user.

file:lib/db/index.ts.name: index.ts
file:lib/db/index.ts.summary: Lazily-constructed Drizzle/node-postgres database client, exposed as `db` through a Proxy so importing this module never opens a connection until a query actually runs — required so CI/CD builds with no DATABASE_URL still succeed.

file:lib/db/schema.ts.name: schema.ts
file:lib/db/schema.ts.summary: The application's full Drizzle ORM schema: Better Auth tables (user/session/account/verification), billing (plans, subscriptions, quotas, quotes, invoices), support requests and messages, attachments, demos and their access/secrets/runs, notifications, activity log, app settings, contact leads, and the owner-editable site content/solutions tables.

file:lib/db/seed.ts.name: seed.ts
file:lib/db/seed.ts.summary: One-off seed script (run by hand, never at app start) that upserts the service catalogue's plans, deactivates ones no longer offered, cancels the legacy free 'Découverte' subscriptions, and fills in any missing default app settings without overwriting admin-edited ones.

file:lib/email.ts.name: email.ts
file:lib/email.ts.summary: Thin wrapper around the Resend API for transactional email: degrades to console-logging the message (including any verification/reset links) when RESEND_API_KEY is unset, so the whole sign-up flow stays completable with no mailbox.

file:lib/format.ts.name: format.ts
file:lib/format.ts.summary: Small collection of locale-aware date, relative-time and byte-size formatting helpers (Africa/Algiers timezone, fr-FR locale) shared across the dashboard and admin UI.

file:lib/guard.ts.name: guard.ts
file:lib/guard.ts.summary: Server-side auth guards used by every dashboard/admin page and server action: reading the current session/user, requiring sign-in or staff role, requiring a specific permission (with a named redirect), and asserting ownership-or-permission for a resource.

file:lib/kv.ts.name: kv.ts
file:lib/kv.ts.summary: Parsing/formatting helpers for the simple 'key: value' text-area format used by a few admin forms (free-form specs and quota grants), including validation of quota grant syntax.

file:lib/permissions.ts.name: permissions.ts
file:lib/permissions.ts.summary: The authorization core: role/permission domain definitions and admin-UI labels, plus can()/isStaff()/effectivePermissions(), which resolve a permission by layering an account's explicit permissions jsonb over its role's defaults.

file:lib/quotas.ts.name: quotas.ts
file:lib/quotas.ts.summary: Consumable-quota engine: granting/revoking a plan's quota metrics to a user, atomically consuming and refunding usage with lazy period resets, and listing a user's quotas and provisioned subscriptions.

file:lib/realtime.ts.name: realtime.ts
file:lib/realtime.ts.summary: Server-Sent-Events backbone built on Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY: publish()/publishMany() NOTIFY a per-user channel after a DB write, and subscribe() (used by the SSE route) registers a callback and lazily owns one dedicated, auto-reconnecting LISTEN client on the unpooled connection.

file:lib/requests.ts.name: requests.ts
file:lib/requests.ts.summary: Domain constants and helpers for support requests: status/type/priority enums and their French labels, the allowed status transition graph, and status-badge color tones.

file:__tests__/document-overrides.test.t.name: document-overrides.test.tsx
file:__tests__/document-overrides.test.t.summary: Vitest suite for per-document company identity overrides: confirms effectiveCompany() falls back to Paramètres for absent keys, lets an empty string blank a printed line, validates parseOverrides()'s JSON handling, and exercises DocumentPreview's editable in-place edits for both a legal-ID field and a line item.

file:__tests__/pdf.test.tsx.name: pdf.test.tsx
file:__tests__/pdf.test.tsx.summary: Node-environment Vitest suite that renders the devis/facture @react-pdf/renderer document (BillingDocument) with a full company identity, with a blank one, and across 60 lines to force pagination, plus a unit check that pdfMoney() encodes with a plain space Helvetica can render.

file:__tests__/platform.test.ts.name: platform.test.ts
file:__tests__/platform.test.ts.summary: Pins the dashboard's pure decision logic with no database involved: the can()/isStaff() authorization model, request status transitions, WC/DV/FA reference-code sequencing, money math (line totals, VAT-free parsing/formatting), quota progress (unlimited vs not-included vs remaining), and derived billing status (en_retard, expired quotes) — documented as rules a UI control and a server action both rely on, so a regression here is a silent authorization or billing bug.

file:app/(app)/admin/abonnements/Service.name: ServiceForm.tsx
file:app/(app)/admin/abonnements/Service.summary: Client form for provisioning or editing a client's subscribed service (subscription), letting the desk pick a catalogue plan to prefill price/period/spec or describe a bespoke service, plus a separate confirm-to-delete form for removing a provisioned service.

file:app/(app)/admin/catalogue/Catalogue.name: CatalogueForm.tsx
file:app/(app)/admin/catalogue/Catalogue.summary: Client form for creating or editing a sellable service-catalogue item (name, category, price, specs, quota grants), plus a type-to-confirm delete form that keeps already-sold subscriptions intact when an offer is removed.

file:app/(app)/admin/demandes/[id]/Reque.name: RequestControls.tsx
file:app/(app)/admin/demandes/[id]/Reque.summary: The four desk-side controls on a client request: change status (only to states nextStatuses() permits), assign an owner and priority, edit the client's own title/description/budget, and a type-to-confirm delete — deliberately four separate forms so each server action logs a distinct, unambiguous change.

file:app/(app)/admin/devis/[id]/QuoteAct.name: QuoteActions.tsx
file:app/(app)/admin/devis/[id]/QuoteAct.summary: Renders only the quote actions valid for its current status: PDF preview/download links, send/resend by e-mail, convert an accepted quote to an invoice, a link to provision the resulting service, and a confirm-to-delete that requires typing the reference once the client has already seen the document.

file:app/(app)/admin/devis/[id]/page.tsx.name: page.tsx
file:app/(app)/admin/devis/[id]/page.tsx.summary: Admin quote detail page: loads the quote with its client, resolves the effective (per-document override) company identity, and renders either the live DocumentEditor (draft/sent quotes) or a read-only DocumentPreview (answered quotes) alongside client info, status, linked invoice and linked request panels.

file:app/(app)/admin/devis/actions.ts.name: actions.ts
file:app/(app)/admin/devis/actions.ts.summary: Server actions for the lifecycle of a quote (devis): save (draft create/update, refuses edits once the client has answered), send/resend by e-mail with PDF attached and client notification, convert an accepted quote into an invoice by copying its lines, and delete (plain confirm for drafts, reference-typed confirm once sent).

file:app/(app)/admin/devis/nouveau/page..name: page.tsx
file:app/(app)/admin/devis/nouveau/page..summary: New-quote admin page: checks quotes:write, loads billable clients and the company identity, optionally prefilling from a linked request id in the query string, and renders the DocumentEditor for a blank devis.

file:app/(app)/admin/factures/InvoiceAct.name: InvoiceActions.tsx
file:app/(app)/admin/factures/InvoiceAct.summary: Invoice-detail action panel: PDF preview/download links, send/resend by e-mail (issues the invoice on first send), and a confirm-to-delete that requires the reference once the invoice has been emitted.

file:app/(app)/admin/factures/InvoiceCon.name: InvoiceControls.tsx
file:app/(app)/admin/factures/InvoiceCon.summary: Small inline form to move an invoice through its statuses (mainly marking it paid) and adjust its due date, since there is no payment provider and a human sets invoice state by hand.

file:app/(app)/admin/factures/[id]/page..name: page.tsx
file:app/(app)/admin/factures/[id]/page..summary: Admin invoice detail page: loads the invoice with its client and originating quote, resolves the effective per-document company identity, and renders the live DocumentEditor for an editable invoice or a read-only DocumentPreview for a closed one, alongside client, status controls and action panels.

file:app/(app)/admin/factures/actions.ts.name: actions.ts
file:app/(app)/admin/factures/actions.ts.summary: Server actions for the invoice lifecycle: save (create/update, refuses paid/cancelled invoices), send/resend by e-mail (issues on first send, stamps issuedAt), status transitions (stamps issuedAt/paidAt on the transition rather than recomputing, notifies the client when marked paid), and delete (plain confirm for drafts, reference-typed confirm once emitted).

file:app/(app)/admin/factures/nouveau/pa.name: page.tsx
file:app/(app)/admin/factures/nouveau/pa.summary: New-invoice admin page: checks invoices:write, loads billable clients and the company identity, and renders the DocumentEditor for a blank facture.

file:app/(app)/admin/journal/PurgeForm.t.name: PurgeForm.tsx
file:app/(app)/admin/journal/PurgeForm.t.summary: Confirm-gated form that purges activity-log entries older than a chosen date; the purge action itself stays recorded in the journal.

file:app/(app)/admin/notifications/envoy.name: BroadcastForm.tsx
file:app/(app)/admin/notifications/envoy.summary: Compose-a-broadcast form: picks a recipient segment (all active, clients only, team, recent signups, or a specific plan's customers) and shows the live recipient count computed server-side before sending a titled message with an optional e-mail copy.

file:app/(app)/admin/notifications/envoy.name: segments.ts
file:app/(app)/admin/notifications/envoy.summary: Shared constant list of broadcast recipient segments (tous, clients, équipe, nouveaux, plan) and their value union, pulled out of the '"use server"' actions file because a server-actions module may only export async functions.

file:app/(app)/admin/parametres/CompanyF.name: CompanyForm.tsx
file:app/(app)/admin/parametres/CompanyF.summary: The header/footer/legal/bank identity printed on every devis and facture PDF: company name, legal IDs (RC/NIF/NIS/AI), bank details, VAT rate, logo/signature pickers, and free-text terms — every field optional so an admin can start sending quotes before the paperwork is fully collected.

file:app/(app)/admin/parametres/Settings.name: SettingsForm.tsx
file:app/(app)/admin/parametres/Settings.summary: Platform-wide switches form: magic-link sign-in, open registration, required e-mail verification, and the announcement banner shown across both dashboard shells.

file:app/(app)/admin/parametres/actions..name: actions.ts
file:app/(app)/admin/parametres/actions..summary: Server actions for platform settings: updateSettings writes each app_settings key individually so a switch un-ticking turns it off rather than leaving it untouched, and updateCompany validates the logo/signature are PNG or JPEG attachments (the PDF engine can't embed anything else) before saving the printed company identity.

file:app/(app)/admin/utilisateurs/[id]/U.name: UserControls.tsx
file:app/(app)/admin/utilisateurs/[id]/U.summary: Every control on the admin user detail page, one form per action: profile fields, role change, the permission-matrix editor (draft state reseeded on role change, only exceptions to the role's defaults are saved), per-metric quota grants, suspend/unsuspend, an internal message, impersonation, and a type-to-confirm irreversible account delete.

file:app/(app)/admin/utilisateurs/nouvea.name: CreateUserForm.tsx
file:app/(app)/admin/utilisateurs/nouvea.summary: Opens a new client or staff account from the back-office; the password field is optional and left blank triggers a generated password shown once in the success banner, which is the whole reason this page exists instead of just sending a sign-up link.

file:app/(app)/dashboard/demandes/nouvel.name: NewRequestForm.tsx
file:app/(app)/dashboard/demandes/nouvel.summary: Client form (`use client`) for submitting a new support/service request, bound to the `createRequest` server action via `useActionState` with no duplicated client-side validation.

file:app/(app)/dashboard/devis/[id]/Quot.name: QuoteDecision.tsx
file:app/(app)/dashboard/devis/[id]/Quot.summary: Client component rendering Accept/Refuse buttons for a quote as one plain form bound to `respondToQuote`, so the decision works before hydration.

file:app/(app)/dashboard/devis/[id]/page.name: page.tsx
file:app/(app)/dashboard/devis/[id]/page.summary: Client-facing quote detail page: fetches an owned, non-draft quote joined to its originating request, shows the line items, PDF links, expiry/status messaging, and the accept/refuse control.

file:app/(app)/dashboard/devis/page.tsx.name: page.tsx
file:app/(app)/dashboard/devis/page.tsx.summary: Client dashboard page listing all quotes issued to the signed-in user, with status chips and an empty state linking to a new request.

file:app/(app)/dashboard/factures/page.t.name: page.tsx
file:app/(app)/dashboard/factures/page.t.summary: Client dashboard page listing invoices with TTC totals (owed vs paid), bank details for outstanding ones, and links to the generated PDF documents.

file:components/dashboard/MoneyLines.tsx.name: MoneyLines.tsx
file:components/dashboard/MoneyLines.tsx.summary: Read-only line-item table shared by quote/invoice detail pages: renders each line's quantity/unit price/subtotal plus the VAT and grand total.

file:components/dashboard/billing/Docume.name: DocumentEditor.tsx
file:components/dashboard/billing/Docume.summary: Staff-side editor for creating/editing a quote or invoice: client picker, line items, currency, notes, and a tabbed panel for per-document company identity overrides, wired to a live `DocumentPreview`.

file:components/dashboard/billing/Docume.name: DocumentPreview.tsx
file:components/dashboard/billing/Docume.summary: HTML mirror of the billing PDF layout used as a live, editable preview: renders at A4 width and scales to fit, with each field a `contentEditable` span that commits on blur.

file:components/dashboard/billing/ImageP.name: ImagePicker.tsx
file:components/dashboard/billing/ImageP.summary: Logo/signature upload control for the document editor: validates PNG/JPEG, uploads via `uploadFile`, and shows a preview with a reset option.

file:components/dashboard/ui.tsx.name: ui.tsx
file:components/dashboard/ui.tsx.summary: Shared dashboard form/UI primitives — labeled inputs, textareas, checkboxes, selects, a submit button, an action-state alert, status chips, an empty state, and a two-step destructive `ConfirmButton` — plus a re-export of HeroUI's `Button`/`Chip`.

file:lib/actions.ts.name: actions.ts
file:lib/actions.ts.summary: Shared server-action plumbing: the `ActionState` shape every dashboard action returns, a `parseForm` helper that validates `FormData` against a Zod schema while preserving typed values on failure, and small `fail`/`succeed` result builders plus reusable Zod fragments for optional text and checkboxes.

file:lib/billing-lines.ts.name: billing-lines.ts
file:lib/billing-lines.ts.summary: Form-parsing helpers for billing documents: reads parallel line-item fields from `FormData` into typed lines, allocates the next sequential document reference for a given prefix/table, and parses/validates company identity overrides including logo/signature attachment checks.

file:lib/billing-preview.ts.name: billing-preview.ts
file:lib/billing-preview.ts.summary: Converts persisted billing lines/cents into the string-based shape the editable `DocumentPreview` form uses, and builds a full preview document object from draft input.

file:lib/billing-send.ts.name: billing-send.ts
file:lib/billing-send.ts.summary: Renders a quote or invoice to PDF, stores it as an attachment when object storage is configured, and e-mails it to the client with a themed message and an in-app link, then stamps `sentAt`/`pdfKey` on the source row.

file:lib/billing.ts.name: billing.ts
file:lib/billing.ts.summary: Status vocabulary and small predicates for quotes and invoices: valid status lists, French labels and status-chip tones, quote-expiry and invoice-overdue detection.

file:lib/company.ts.name: company.ts
file:lib/company.ts.summary: The default company identity used on billing documents, the field keys that can be overridden per document, a length-capped Zod schema for those overrides, and `effectiveCompany`/`parseOverrides` to merge and validate them.

file:lib/money.ts.name: money.ts
file:lib/money.ts.summary: Money primitives used everywhere billing amounts are handled: cents-based line/total sums, French currency formatting, a tolerant string-to-cents parser, and `withVat` for the one TTC formula.

file:lib/pdf/BillingDocument.tsx.name: BillingDocument.tsx
file:lib/pdf/BillingDocument.tsx.summary: `@react-pdf/renderer` document component rendering a devis or facture as a styled A4 PDF — header, client block, line-item table, totals, bank details and legal footer — using company identity resolved per document.

file:lib/pdf/render.ts.name: render.ts
file:lib/pdf/render.ts.summary: Server-side PDF renderer: loads a quote or invoice with its client, resolves the effective company identity, fetches the logo/signature bytes from object storage, and renders `BillingDocument` to a PDF buffer.

file:lib/quota-labels.ts.name: quota-labels.ts
file:lib/quota-labels.ts.summary: Display labels and tones for the services/subscriptions/quotas domain: metric names, a standing-vs-consumable metric check, subscription status labels/tones, and service category/billing-period labels.

file:lib/ref.ts.name: ref.ts
file:lib/ref.ts.summary: Builds and parses the `PREFIX-YYMM-NNNN` reference codes used for requests, quotes and invoices, and computes the next sequence number per prefix/period from the existing refs (the caller retries on a unique-index collision).

file:lib/server/queries.ts.name: queries.ts
file:lib/server/queries.ts.summary: Central server-only Drizzle query layer for the dashboard/admin: requests, messages, attachments, documents (quotes/invoices), demo runs, contact leads, staff assignees, admin/client dashboard counters, the unread-lead badge count, a merged request thread, and the billable-clients list.

file:lib/settings.ts.name: settings.ts
file:lib/settings.ts.summary: Typed key/value app settings store (`app_settings`): defaults, allowed keys, get/set helpers, and `getDocumentCompany`/`getCompany` which resolve the stored company identity (optionally merged with per-document overrides) for billing documents.

file:components/ui/Accordion.tsx.name: Accordion.tsx
file:components/ui/Accordion.tsx.summary: Expandable FAQ/accordion list primitive with GSAP-animated open/close height transitions and single-item-open behavior.

file:components/ui/Badge.tsx.name: Badge.tsx
file:components/ui/Badge.tsx.summary: Small pill-shaped label primitive used for eyebrow/mini-title badges across marketing sections.

file:components/ui/Button.tsx.name: Button.tsx
file:components/ui/Button.tsx.summary: Primary button/link primitive with primary/secondary/ghost variants and an optional animated trailing arrow icon.

file:components/ui/Container.tsx.name: Container.tsx
file:components/ui/Container.tsx.summary: Centered max-width layout wrapper (1280px) with responsive horizontal padding, used to align section content site-wide.

file:components/ui/ErrorBoundary.tsx.name: ErrorBoundary.tsx
file:components/ui/ErrorBoundary.tsx.summary: Class-based React error boundary that swaps in a fallback UI when a non-essential widget (e.g. the WebGL hero scene) throws, instead of crashing the page.

file:components/ui/HandUnderline.tsx.name: HandUnderline.tsx
file:components/ui/HandUnderline.tsx.summary: Shared hand-drawn SVG underline used to accent key words (e.g. in HighlightsReel and DeviceShowcase); fills with the signal accent color and lets the caller control the draw-in animation via className.

file:components/ui/Icon.tsx.name: Icon.tsx
file:components/ui/Icon.tsx.summary: Shared stroke-icon component rendering a 24x24 SVG path from a hand-drawn registry covering both marketing icons and dashboard chrome icons (bell, settings, panel-left-close, sun/moon, etc.), keyed by IconName.

file:components/ui/LivePreview.tsx.name: LivePreview.tsx
file:components/ui/LivePreview.tsx.summary: Iframe component that embeds a live external site at a real desktop/mobile viewport and scales it down to fit its box, layered over a fallback and gated by a server-side embeddability check plus a load timeout.

file:components/ui/LoadingImage.tsx.name: LoadingImage.tsx

service:Dockerfile.name: Dockerfile
service:Dockerfile.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for the production Next.js 16 image: installs dependencies with a frozen pnpm lockfile, builds the standalone output with the public NEXT_PUBLIC_* build args, then ships a minimal Alpine runtime that runs as a non-root user on port 3000.

service:Dockerfile:base.name: base
service:Dockerfile:base.summary: Base stage: node:22-alpine with libc6-compat installed (for native deps expecting glibc symbols on musl) and Corepack enabled for pnpm; every later stage builds from it.

service:Dockerfile:deps.name: deps
service:Dockerfile:deps.summary: Installs dependencies with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` from only the lockfile-affecting files (package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, pnpm-workspace.yaml), so this layer caches across source-only changes.

service:Dockerfile:builder.name: builder
service:Dockerfile:builder.summary: Copies node_modules from deps plus the full source, injects NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY as build ARGs (Next inlines NEXT_PUBLIC_* vars into the client bundle at build time, not at container start), and runs `pnpm build`.

service:Dockerfile:runner.name: runner
service:Dockerfile:runner.summary: Minimal runtime stage: creates an unprivileged nextjs user, copies public/ and the traced standalone server plus static assets from builder, and runs `node server.js` on port 3000.

service:.dockerignore.name: .dockerignore
service:.dockerignore.summary: Build-context exclusions for the Docker image: strips node_modules, build output, VCS/CI/editor files, local tooling/docs, and every .env* secret except .env.example, so none of it is baked into an image layer.

step:.github/workflows/ci-cd.yml:verify.name: verify
step:.github/workflows/ci-cd.yml:verify.summary: Quality-gate job that checks out the repo, installs dependencies with pnpm, then runs lint, tests, a production build, and typecheck on every push and PR.

step:.github/workflows/ci-cd.yml:docker.name: docker
step:.github/workflows/ci-cd.yml:docker.summary: Publish job, gated on the verify job and on pushes to main, that logs into Docker Hub, derives image tags, and builds/pushes the image with GitHub Actions layer caching and public NEXT_PUBLIC_* build args.
